|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. The current text is [[Unexpected Interruption (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-47-Unexpected_Interruption-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Unexpected Interruption (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent’s female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > target’s ability, target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor’s for remainder of turn.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 47. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-47-Unexpected_Interruption.png]]) prints slip number “47” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) moved the condition “if destiny +2 > target's ability” to the end of the last sentence: “If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent's female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. Target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor's for remainder of turn if destiny +2 > target's ability.”.<ref name="cl-1240_47-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Unexpected Interruption (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-unexpectedinterruption-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual4-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/unexpectedinterruption.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034634/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual4-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Dark/large/unexpectedinterruption.gif</ref>: “If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent's female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > target's ability, target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor's for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “47” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Unexpected Interruption (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 39), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=39, page 39. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=39 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent's female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > target's ability, target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor's for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-47-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
